Trips include coastal, Coronado Islands, offshore banks, trophy bluefin, shark, swordfish, and lobster seasons. They provide all necessary gear and assistance to help guests catch fish and enjoy the experience.

quotes.author: Kyle Thompson
quotes.text: Kyle Thompson7 months agoI have taken over a hundred charters in SoCal, and the one I just took with Captain Travis was by far the best ever. We booked 5 for those on our annual corporate off-site that didn't want to golf, and 3 of them had never been on a charter before. Travis was great with everyone, helping bait, fix line issues and even filleted our catch. Brothers has state of the art sonar and they know exactly where to go to hit productive spots. The five of us caught 27 whitefish, honeycomb, mackerel, sand dabs, redfish and lyncod.

quotes.author: Carmelo Moyet
quotes.text: Carmelo Moyet1 year agoI've booked trips twice with brothers fishing, both times with captain Zeke and both times did not disappoint. He takes care of literally EVERYTHING for you. All you have to do is sit back and fish. My last trip was a shark excursion and we ended up hooking on an almost 6ft blue shark. These guys know what they are doing and Capt Zeke knows how to captain a vessel and always puts you in the fish. Highly recommend.

quotes.author: Virgil Lucero
quotes.text: Virgil Lucero8 months agoCaptain Scotty has a great crew to handle all the boats. We went out with Captain Andy, and from the start Andy set out to find where the tuna schools were. It took some time but it was absolutely worth it once we were in the middle of the boil!Give them a chance to do their thing to find the spots where the fish are and your patience will pay off. Glad I went with Brothers fishing and not on a crowded boat.

quotes.author: Joseph Stout
quotes.text: Joseph Stout10 months agoGreat experience fishing, from the first phone call to time we stepped off the boat nothing but first class service! Capt Travis shared a wealth of knowledge and worked all day putting us on fish and didn’t disappoint. Great communication throughout from booking to fishing. Highly recommend going fishing with this company great group of guys! Thanks Travis for a memorable trip!

R. M.1 year agoCapt. Noah put us on Yellowtail for the Coronado 3/4 trip. He made a valiant effort to keep us in the action. We've had other guides who don't appear to be fishermen at heart but Noah stopped the boat on the way back in to throw, lol, just one more cast 😆. That's the guy you want to fish with! Great service, great experience, great fishermen.Thanks Scottie and Noah!-Rob & Alex

quotes.author: kun-yu Teng
quotes.text: kun-yu Teng1 year agoWe booked a half day trip to celebrate our son’s birthday with Brother Sport Fishing. All of us are beginners in ocean fishing. However, Captain Travis and Jackson made it easy for us. They did a good job finding the fishes and showed us how to catch them. It was a great experience and we highly recommended them!!!
